mainEntity.name: Where is Abirami Natural Beauty Parlour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Find us at No.1/11, Rice Mill Rd, Jalladiampet, Medavakkam, Chennai 600100. Use the directions link for your route.

mainEntity.name: How do I book an appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Booking is through WhatsApp. Send your name, the service you want to ask about and a preferred date. Your appointment is confirmed only after the salon replies. The booking link will appear when the verified number is added.

mainEntity.name: Where can I check prices and service availability?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prices are on consultation. Please confirm the service, price and available time directly with the salon before making plans.

mainEntity.name: Are the photographs and reviews shown here real client work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only approved photographs and supplied reviews will be published as client work. Any empty image spaces are clearly marked as placeholders.
